title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs Security Update
description: A vulnerability (CVE-2026-115455) was found in GCC libstdc++ where extracting data into a bitset from a wide-character stream causes improper stack memory allocation, leading to a stack-based buffer overflow. This can result in a denial of service (DoS) when an attacker supplies crafted input. The issue affects Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs for gcc13 and related packages. The vulnerability is rated as moderate impact due to its uncommon exploitation scenario and the presence of stack-hardening features that cause affected binaries to abort on stack corruption.
